readme:
# This account

This is the video ad account for a poker training app. Its video ads run on the platform behind the `sim` command; `sim catalog` describes what the platform offers and how a video is made.

Ticks run for you every 12 hours.

To reach me, run `notify`; `notify --help` says how it works.

This account has no Google access; keep the hill climb's workbook as CSV files in `workbook/`.

Reports for me go in `reports/` as HTML or Markdown files.
setup_prompt: /hill-climb Set up a hill climb on this video ad account to get the cost of a conversion as low as possible. You have $600; ask me if you need more.
